# M12 remaining measurement services — preimplementation design

Status: source and hand-reference preparation only. This extends the already registered M12/L02/L03 engineering family without changing its golden cases, protocol or initial implementation. It joins the user's single M01–M13 implementation, review, repair and verification batch. It does not close the empirical, policy or future phases.

## Scope and existing contracts

M12 and M12.REFERENCE_TYPES retain their entire ten-part card, SR-M12, UP-M12, both P0–P7 programs and applicable UPK-01/04/05/10 plus the acyclic-port rules. All 66 directly routed source rows, three PIN019 rows explicitly named by the parent card, and all 12 INV rows remain individually accounted for. The prior completed original-reading proofs are reused only for their exact unchanged extents. Supplied constants remain source claims, never fitted probabilities.

Existing `ReferencePrice`, `ReferenceSet`, `OfficialSettlement`, `ReferenceGap`, F03 calendar/interval types, F04 raw coordinates/bridges, F09 bars, F10 and V01/V02 wires remain unchanged. New implementation lives in `measurements/reference_geometry.py`, with independent primitive arithmetic in `references/reference_geometry_literal.py` and assertions in `tests/test_reference_geometry.py`. Shared captured trade evidence comes from the separately registered `measurements.common` port. Actual registry publication uses the common anchored measurement adapter owned by the profile implementation; there is no second registry.

## Early and source-specific opens

`observe_open(selection, view, *, coverage, cut, published_at, horizon_end, semantic, limits)` validates the actual `ClockSelection` against its calendar and interval graph and captures the exact TradeView prefix. The window is [start,end); only eligible whole prints in the selected window known by cut enter. Publication is after the captured cut and every admitted input. Raw instrument and aggregation unit match the actual source. The result retains the selection, captured evidence and immutable request, the separately typed certified open and first-observed diagnostic, incomplete-open status and any tied first-price set.

A certified first eligible print needs contiguous observed coverage from the actual named start through that print and complete source history for that prefix. Healthy time without a print is not a missing opening tick. A later print after a missing opening interval is only `first_observed_trade`. An unknown-order first-time batch with different prices cannot identify the open; an equal-price batch can. Source observations at the exact cut are usable only if included in observed coverage; no integer `cut+1` outside the timestamp domain is constructed. The start and end are supplied canonical calendar instants, not chart indices or a hand-adjusted offset. An open can publish before its enclosing session has closed. An opening-candle close remains unavailable until the actual completed candle publication; it is a separate reference.

The same service supports every disclosed scheduled/session/hour open through its own F03 definition. Source-specific clocks stay distinct: PIN012's 16 explicit minute opens; PIN025's 11 opening-candle open/close pairs; PIN015/032/039/040/041/047/061/064/066/073/074/076/080/081/082 clocks; and original versus corrected PIN074 fifth-window variants. Display toggles, drawing limits, `valuewhen` carryover and a change in the numerical open do not select dates or readiness. A wider max-open window is a separately named alternative, never the first-open definition. The final protocol retains a source-variant disposition table instead of claiming these clock definitions implement the sources' later C/L/R forecasts.

`period_open(...)` selects daily, ISO trading-week, calendar-month, quarter or year membership from explicit civil trading dates. It resolves every intervening calendar date from the period's true first date through the selected first eligible session at the frozen cut, including explicit closed dates. Missing calendar evidence stops selection. It consumes bounded per-session open observations with exact same-date/session/raw-instrument bindings. Completely observed quiet earlier sessions can precede the first print in a later eligible session; missing earlier observation downgrades a later print to a first-observed diagnostic. ISO week-year is separate from civil year. No prior period or last available array index substitutes for the declared period. For a current period, it cannot use any future print or calendar revision after cut. The result keeps all traversed calendar versions and the selected underlying open observation.

## Typed relative geometry and scale

`PriorReferenceScale` is a new exact record of id, definition version, raw instrument, positive or zero Fraction tick scale, formation_start/end, published_at, source versions and observed support. Service admission binds its raw instrument to the references; formation_end must be no later than the current opening observation and its publication must be known at the gap cut. Zero/unavailable scale keeps raw gap and direction but makes normalization unavailable; it never divides by an epsilon. Negative scale, wrong raw units, future formation/publication or malformed identities reject.

`normalized_gap(current, prior, *, scale, cut, published_at, maximum_age_ns)` preserves both reference versions/types, current-minus-prior raw tick and point differences, sign including zero, each reference's observation/publication age, scale version and normalized gap. It checks support, publication and expiry individually. Known publication age equal to the supplied maximum is admitted; one ns older is unavailable. The scale is prior observed measurement, not a future full-session statistic. No percentage or log return is fabricated for a zero/negative denominator.

`ReferenceGraph` retains bounded uniquely identified typed vertices and requested directed differences, with original raw reference values, types, observation instants, provenance and ages. Every edge requires both endpoints known at cut, exact raw coordinate compatibility and separate requested publication. Same numerical values with different reference types or publication histories remain distinct vertices. Duplicate same-id/same-version references collapse idempotently; conflicting bytes under an id/version reject. On compatible triples, edge sums reconcile exactly. Consensus is an explicitly derived weighted mean only within a declared same-kind, same-observation, same-raw-coordinate cohort with nonnegative exact weights and positive total; unlike types are not silently averaged into a settlement or open. The graph reports the typed cohort's min/max/spread and original members. Pairwise differences can compare distinct types while retaining the convention.

An adjacent `ReferenceCoordinateBinding` validates an actual F02 `InstrumentDefinition` against every F10 Instrument field (provider, venue, raw ID/symbol, definition version, tick size, valid interval, expiry; futures only here) and derives an actual F04 `RawCoordinate` including explicit currency evidence. A bridge gap uses the actual `RollBridge`, exact matching source/destination bindings, its availability at cut and publication, and its uncertainty. Compute in points: raw difference = destination current − source prior; mapped market difference = destination current − (source prior + bridge spread). Raw difference equals mapped market difference plus bridge spread. Convert to destination ticks explicitly. Retain bridge/source-coordinate identities and uncertainty; adjusted display series, undeclared reused lifetimes, stale/asynchronous bridges and cross-currency mismatches do not qualify. No synthetic reference replaces an absent official settlement.

## Source arithmetic constructions

Keep all existing body25/range25/midpoint calculations. Add exact named two-reference interpolation `(1-p)*forecast_open + p*reference_open` with both endpoint identities, including p=0, p=1 and zero displacement. Ordinary retracement restricts 0<=p<=1; extrapolation is a separate explicitly named definition with a declared finite ratio bound. Parent range fractions preserve the original origin/direction. Support is inherited from exactly the fields required by that formula, not the whole enclosing bar by accident.

Add the source PIN013 floor-pivot family from one completed, certified, same-period H/L/C set: P=(H+L+C)/3; R1=2P-L, S1=2P-H; R2/S2=P±(H-L); R3=H+2(P-L), S3=L-2(H-P); R4/R5 and S4/S5 add/subtract one further range each. Daily and each adjacent pivot interval expose the source .5–.618 band, with from-top and from-bottom origins named and geometric bounds sorted. No close is renamed settlement. Preserve exact fractional ticks before any separately declared execution rounding. Mixed period versions, unsupported required fields and inverted H/L reject; zero-width produces explicit degenerate geometry rather than an implied useful band.

## Gap event outcomes

`GapTarget` freezes current/prior reference versions, exact reference level, initial price, cut, fixed end, observation process, contact mode and gap direction. Target construction requires both references available at cut; later settlement/reference revisions never rewrite this target. Future gap outcomes are a separate research output, not an opening feature.

The observed path uses existing V01 `ExactPoint` and `ObservationWindow` contracts, retaining each price's known time and actual source ordering. Event domain is (cut,end], consistent with the existing label service; optional contact-at-cut is a separate observable condition. Exact traded contact, jump across without a trade, strict closing through, and holding on the filled side after first contact are separate fields. For a positive opening gap, closed-through means terminal < reference; for a negative gap it means terminal > reference. Holding includes equality and requires every later observed mark on the filled side. Zero gap admits contact-at-cut but directional closed-through/hold is not applicable. A healthy quiet horizon uses the declared last-observed-price process, including the initial mark, without inventing additional trades.

Unknown-order batches retain the set of compatible outcomes with bounded permutation work; no ID sort manufactures order. Full-horizon fields are null on pending/censored support. An actually observed contact before a later gap can remain a separately identified partial fact. Full no-fill requires complete observed horizon; absence of a future receipt is not no-fill. Maturity is at least the latest point known_at and coverage certification. The output's version includes the frozen target, retained evidence and definition. A fresh restore recomputes from the retained original request/inputs, or the actual V01 evidence ledger; it never treats an arbitrary precomputed JSON scalar as proof.

## Bounds and evidence

All limits are explicit positive exact integers, excluding bool. Default ceilings for this new family: references256, edges4096, period calendar days366, captured source inputs4096, source identities4096, point observations4096, unknown-order batch8, distinct outcomes4096, permutation transition work65536, UTF-8 identity bytes256, retained request/result bytes8MiB. Reject cardinality before copying/encoding or calling a producer; charge every attempted state/permutation/point transition before enumeration. Configurations are retained and hashed. Boundary vectors use small exact capacity and one-over cases. No accepted legacy wire is changed.

The original 32 M12/L02/L03 vectors remain mandatory. The new MR vectors add early open, period, graph, scale, bridge, source arithmetic and gap-event assertions. All former563 shared tests, all current C01/L01/B00.6/V01/V02 cases, and all M01–M13 cases run in one registered resource-supervised worker after the full implementation review and one consolidated repair. No private candidate import, compile, market scan, fit, benchmark or test occurs during preparation. Full market data certification, conditional gap frequency/logistic/survival training, matched-date downstream comparisons, policy economics and prospective parity remain separate phase dependencies with exact coverage accounting.

## Required child horizons and authenticated scale completion

The child explicitly requires 5/15/60-minute and session-remainder gap targets. `gap_targets` freezes each endpoint independently at the original cut using the actual F03 selected session end for the remainder. It rejects an endpoint beyond that declared session when the selected horizon policy requires same-session observation; it never chooses a horizon after seeing a fill. MR41 covers all four endpoints with one primitive price path and exact, separately matured outcomes.

`gap_held` means every observed future mark remains strictly on the opening side of the frozen prior reference. `gap_traversed` means at least one observed future mark reaches or passes the far endpoint of the original open-to-prior gap (the prior reference). `touched` requires an actual trade exactly at that endpoint. Thus a jump can traverse without a traded fill; a touch can satisfy both. These fields do not mean `held_after_contact`, which describes staying on the filled side after the first actual touch. Zero-direction gaps have no directional held/traversed result. Pending/censored full outcomes remain null. Unknown order preserves these order-invariant facts while terminal/post-contact facts may remain ambiguous.

PriorReferenceScale is produced by an actual-source factory and revalidated from its full retained recipe. Supported deterministic recipes are mean absolute tick changes within fully covered ordered preceding captured trade windows and mean true range of actual retained complete preceding F09 bars with the required previous close. Every input is authenticated through common/F09, source IDs bind full content, and scales cannot be certified by a caller-set support boolean or version string. Formation/publication must precede the current opening observation as described above. Zero observed scale remains explicit and leaves raw gap available. Further fitted scale estimators require the actual shared F11 boundary and a separately registered recipe.
remaining: Native archive quality and supported eligible dates.
Chronological empirical gap/logistic/survival and source conditional models.
Matched C/L/G/R downstream information and capacity comparisons.
E0–E5 complete policy economics and prospective parity.
